cited.quote: Memorandum presented on 17.06.2021 for a permanent solution by restoring
Government of Tamil Nadu has filed counter affidavit in the

rationale: The promise is directional (take steps to reclaim Katchatheevu). C1 records the Chief Minister's Memorandum to the Prime Minister on 17.06.2021 seeking restoration of sovereignty over Katchatheevu, a formal step on the same issue after the government took office. C2 adds the State's counter affidavit in the Supreme Court.

cited.quote: Vaccination against Foot and Mouth Disease and Brucellosis is carried out for entire bovine population

rationale: Extracts C1-C3 describe FMD vaccination under the national programme, which is not awareness creation or expert training of villagers on treatment. C4 and C5 concern diabetic foot care and are unrelated. Only related activity, no official step for the promised awareness and training.

cited.quote: Rs.1,400/- per month as food allowance is given to the students staying in the school hostels.

rationale: C4 shows food allowance amounts in 2025 but no revision order or periodic revision mechanism linked to food inflation. C1 and C2 concern the miscellaneous allowance, not the food allowance. C3 and C5 are travel and daily allowances for officials, a different group. No official step shown.

cited.quote: District Collectors review the status of grievances disposal every Monday.

rationale: No extract shows a quarterly grievance meeting for fishermen with the Fisheries minister and District Collector. C1 and C2 cover pensioners' grievance meetings, C3 and C4 the general CM Helpline, C5 a water board meeting. All are related grievance activity for other groups.

cited.quote: inclusion of fishermen community as a coastal tribe under the Scheduled Tribes

rationale: C2 only mentions the inclusion of fishermen as a Scheduled Tribe as an aspiration in a policy note, with no GO, resolution or letter. C1 and C3 show a central Act adding Narikoravan, not fishermen. No official state step for this commitment.

cited.quote: Surgery, Chemotherapy, Radiotherapy and Immunotherapy for all Malignancies including inpatient procedures for diagnosis
All diseases under the proposed scheme shall be covered from day one.

rationale: C5 is the GO of 2021-06-29 implementing the employees' health insurance scheme, and C1 the 2022 pensioners' GO, both cashless and covering malignancies, heart and kidney conditions. Cover is capped (up to Rs.10 lakh for specified illnesses), so the 100% cover element is not shown. Hence partial.

None of the extracts concerns a Right to Services Act or a statutory guarantee of timely delivery of certificates. C2 and C4 are about the Right to Information Act, C1 about disability rights, C3 about GST and C5 about community certificate appeals. Nothing is about the commitment.

cited.quote: conducts Monthly Review Meetings with all Secretaries to Government

rationale: C2 shows periodic CM reviews and monthly reviews by the Chief Secretary, not a CM review on the first working day of every month, and no report card to the Press. C1, C3, C4 and C5 are on other subjects. No dedicated official step for this commitment.

cited.quote: The Insurance Company shall arrange to issue identity cards to cover the beneficiaries

rationale: C1 and C5 show health insurance schemes issuing ordinary identity cards for cashless treatment, with no smart card technology mentioned. C2-C4 describe smart family cards for the Public Distribution System, a different object. No official step for smart cards in health insurance.

cited.quote: A Committee has been constituted to fix Key Performance Indicators (KPI) for disbursement of subsidies

rationale: C1 and C2 describe a new KPI committee, fare policy and revenue ideas for the transport undertakings, but none refers to the 2018 committee or its recommendations. C3, C4 and C5 are on unrelated subjects. Only related activity, so not started.
